emilink.configuration.title: EmiLink Config
emilink.config.general.debugMode.tooltip:
Print debug logs.
Also shows debug chat messages.
emilink.config.cache.cacheTTLMs.tooltip:
How long AE query results are kept.
Unit: milliseconds.
How long missing-item results are kept.
Unit: milliseconds.
emilink.config.cache.debounceMs.tooltip:
How long to hover before querying.
Unit: milliseconds.
emilink.config.cache.batchFlushMs.toolti:
How often AE batch queries are sent.
Unit: milliseconds.
emilink.config.emi_ui.wbFillInputGrid.to:
When Wrap as Book is on:
place the original output into an empty input slot.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableDragFill.too: Drag EMI stacks into the search field.
emilink.config.emi_ui.enableMobSeparator:
Move mob-related EMI index entries into a separated section.
Disable in large modpacks to reduce sidebar render cost.
emilink.config.emi_ui.bookmarkPriority.t:
When encoding processing patterns:
prefer items from EMI favorites.
Minimum favorite pages kept available.
Long MOB trees may still add temporary pages.
emilink.config.emi_ui.searchHistoryPosit:
OFF disables search history.
AUTO keeps the adaptive default.
ABOVE, LEFT, and RIGHT force the history beside the EMI search box.
emilink.config.ae_network.enableAeNetwor:
Read AE stored and craftable states.
Used by tooltips, badges, and quick craft.
emilink.config.ae_network.enableNetworkB:
Show AE state on EMI stacks.
Green: stored. Yellow: craftable.
emilink.config.ae_network.enableCraftabl:
Query AE craftability for network badges.
Disable on large AE networks to show stored-item badges only.
emilink.config.ae_network.initialBadgeSc:
How many EMI stacks are queried immediately when opening an AE terminal.
Set to 0 to disable the initial scan.
emilink.config.ae_network.networkBadgeSt:
1: bottom-right filled square.
2: top-left hollow border.
emilink.config.ae_network.extractModifie:
Click EMI stacks to extract from network.
SHIFT, CONTROL, ALT, or OFF.
emilink.config.ae_network.enableAeDeposi:
Click the EMI sidebar with a carried item.
Requires a wireless terminal or open AE terminal.
emilink.config.ae_network.depositBatchMo:
Modifier for depositing all matching items.
SHIFT, CONTROL, ALT, or OFF.
emilink.config.quick_craft.enableQuickCr:
Only works on final outputs in the EMI BOM tree.
Default: Shift+C.
emilink.config.quick_craft.quickCraftMod:
Modifier used for quick crafting the BOM final output.
SHIFT, CONTROL, ALT, or OFF.
emilink.config.quick_craft.quickCraftKey:
Main key used for quick crafting the BOM final output.
Default: C. Supports letters, digits, F1-F25, SPACE, TAB, etc.
emilink.config.inventory.enableBulkTrans:
Bulk transfer items in regular containers.
Disable if another mod conflicts.
emilink.config.inventory.enableDiscardMa:
Hover a slotted item, then press Ctrl+Shift+the vanilla drop key.
IPN locked slots are skipped.
emilink.config.debug.enableDebugPacketLi:
Limit debug packet frequency.
Useful when testing noisy logs.
